title: Physiotherapy informed by acceptance and commitment therapy for chronic low back pain: A randomized trial
comparison_or_design: The PACT-versus-usual-physiotherapy comparison with DNS-based graded exercise.
time_scope: Baseline and immediately after the 6-week intervention.
excluded: Disability, pain acceptance, exercise adherence and autonomy support
Other follow-up times and non-SRQ-E outcomes
population_or_material: Participants with chronic low back pain in the PACT-versus-usual-care randomized comparison.
requested_items: Four SRQ-E subscale arm means at baseline/post; arm changes with within-group tests/effect sizes; between-group effect sizes/tests for baseline, post and change. Do not force conflicting effect-size labels into a single inferred metric.
case_specific_rules: An explicitly labelled row test plus the source test-to-effect-size convention may identify the metric. Where the abstract and matching table/method disagree about the metric, retain a generic reported effect size and mark the metric unresolved. An unlabelled row test does not establish a metric.

Preserve table qualitative grades as source-reported when they conflict with stated cutoffs; do not reclassify them. Retain unexplained printing suffixes in the review record without inventing their meaning or changing the numerical component. Keep each independent effect size separate from its raw change.
